title: Adv. Eng. II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**




+ Design, develop, and customize Alfresco Content Services solutions, including workflows, custom content models, and integrations with external systems.
+ Deploy and manage Alfresco instances on AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM), leveraging cloud services for scalability, security, and high availability.
+ Integrate Alfresco with other applications using microservices architecture (Spring Boot), REST APIs, and Node.js services.
+ Build and maintain modern front-end components for Alfresco applications using Angular and JavaScript.
+ Integrate, configure, and optimize Apache Solr for advanced search capabilities within Alfresco solutions, ensuring fast and accurate content retrieval.
+ Apply SQL expertise for efficient data storage, retrieval, and performance tuning within Alfresco deployments.
+ Monitor and tune Alfresco performance, including database connection pools, Solr indexing, and AWS resource utilization.
+ Debug and resolve technical issues related to Alfresco, SQL, AWS, JavaScript frameworks, and Solr components.
+ Work closely with cross-functional teams, including architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders, to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals.
+ Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration guides, and user manuals, to support ongoing development and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**




+ 5+ years of hands-on experience with Alfresco Content Services (Enterprise Edition).
+ 2+ years of experience working with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM).
+ Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Framework, and RESTful APIs.
+ Experience in designing and implementing Alfresco content models, behaviours, web scripts, workflows, and REST APIs.
+ Experience developing integrations with external systems and building modern front-end components using Angular/ADF (Alfresco Development Framework).
+ Familiarity with ACS and APS SDKs.

* Preferred/Good to Have:

+ Experience with ACS 6.x or later versions and understanding of the latest architecture.
+ Exposure to CI/CD processes using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub.
+ Hands-on experience with Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
+ Certification in Alfresco Content Services or AWS (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer).
+ Experience with Alfresco integrations using AWS S3 for content storage or AWS Aurora for database management.
+ Familiarity with microservices architecture and serverless computing on AWS.
+ Knowledge of other ECM platforms or programming languages (Python, Kotlin).

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
+ Excellent communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
Yes
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares
* Dress for your Day

In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.

title: Developer II-.Net Fullstack Developer
description:
**Overview**
As a Software Developer II on the Smart Water pod, you will build the customer-facing Smart Water experience inside the RealPage Smart Building Portal and the services behind it. You will work across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL, integrating meter and usage data from upstream systems.
  
  
A core part of the mission is making Smart Water scale: replacing today's manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service workflows, hardening the data-ingestion pipeline, and building water-usage anomaly detection that flags running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, and abnormal consumption for operators.
  
  
This role suits a developer with a few years of full-stack experience who wants to own medium-sized features end to end in a small, high-ownership pod and grow into the product's AI roadmap (a Smart Water MCP that powers a Lumina Copilot).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Smart Water features across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL.
* Integrate meter, usage, and occupancy data from upstream systems and improve the reliability of the ingestion pipeline.
* Develop water-usage anomaly detection that surfaces sustained anomalies (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) from interval meter data.
* Replace manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service setup and data-management workflows.
* Surface Smart Water inside the Smart Building Portal (SBP) and contribute to the Smart Water MCP that powers Lumina AI workflows.
* Write clean, well-tested code and partner closely with the pod's QA engineer on quality and data integrity.

**Qualifications**
This is a full-stack role on a C#/.NET 8 and Angular codebase backed by MSSQL.
  
  

* 2+ years building production software, full- stack or backend-leaning.
* Proficiency in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Web API) and solid SQL / relational data-modeling skills (MSSQL).
* Front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework.
* Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs and working with upstream/third-party data sources.
* Comfort writing tested, maintainable code and working in a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Required**
**Preferred Skills but not required**

* Experience with data-pipeline / ingestion work and diagnosing data-quality issues.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch .
* Interest in applied AI — building MCP servers or LLM-powered features (e.g., a Lumina Copilot).
* Familiarity with OIDC / single sign-on integration.

title: Presales (Data, AI & Fullstack) - Senior Consultant
description:
**Presales – Data / AI / Full Stack**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a
**Presales professional**
with strong experience in
**Data, AI, and Full Stack technologies**
to support business development, solutioning, and client engagements. The role will involve understanding client requirements, designing technical solutions, preparing proposals, and supporting sales teams during the complete presales cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**




+ Understand client business and technical requirements and translate them into effective technology solutions.
+ Develop solution approaches, architectures, and technical proposals across Data, AI, and Full Stack technologies.
+ Prepare RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, SOWs, and solution documents.
+ Conduct client presentations, technical discussions, demos, and solution walkthroughs.
+ Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Architects, and Engineering teams to create winning solutions.
+ Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud, and Full Stack technologies.
+ Provide effort estimates, high-level project plans, and technology recommendations.
+ Support proof-of-concepts (POCs) and technical demonstrations.
+ Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack development.
+ Participate in client workshops and requirement-gathering sessions.
+ Support the sales team in identifying new opportunities and strengthening existing client relationships.

**Required Skills**




+ Strong understanding of Data Engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, and Full Stack development.
+ Knowledge of Python, Java/.NET, React/Angular, APIs, Microservices, and databases.
+ Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
+ Knowledge of data technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Data Lake, ETL/ELT, and BI tools.
+ Understanding of AI/ML frameworks, LLMs, GenAI, RAG, and AI application development.
+ Strong solution architecture and technical documentation skills.
+ Excellent communication, presentation, and client-facing skills.
+ Ability to work effectively with Sales, Delivery, and Technical teams.

**Experience**




+ 8+ years of overall experience in technology, solutioning, consulting, or presales.
+ Relevant experience in Data / AI / Full Stack Presales or Solution Architecture is preferred.

**Preferred**




+ Experience handling RFP/RFI/RFQ and large enterprise proposals.
+ Experience in client-facing roles and technical presentations.
+ Experience supporting sales pursuits in the US/global market.
+ Relevant cloud or AI certifications will be an added advantage.

title: Solution Architect (AI / Data / Full Stack) - Senior Principal Consultant
description:
Solution Architect – AI / Data / Full Stack
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect**
with strong expertise in
**AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack technologies**
. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions and working closely with clients, business teams, and engineering teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design end-to-end technology solutions across AI, Data, Cloud, and Full Stack platforms.
* Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable solution architectures.
* Define application architecture, technology stack, integration patterns, APIs, and data architecture.
* Design solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Analytics.
* Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to development and engineering teams.
* Review technical designs, code approaches, and architecture decisions.
* Support POCs, technical evaluations, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with Presales and Sales teams on RFPs, proposals, estimations, and client presentations.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, performance, availability, and maintainability.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend suitable solutions based on business needs.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in Solution Architecture and Enterprise Application Design.
* Strong knowledge of AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI application development.
* Strong understanding of Data Engineering, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT, Databricks, Snowflake, and Analytics.
* Good experience with Full Stack technologies such as Python/Java/.NET, React/Angular, APIs, and Microservices.
* Strong knowledge of Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms.
* Experience with databases, distributed systems, integration, and API architecture.
* Strong understanding of security, scalability, performance, and cloud architecture.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client-facing skills.

* 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, architecture, or technology consulting.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect / Technical Architect across AI, Data, Cloud, or Full Stack technologies.

* Experience working with enterprise/global clients.
* Experience in client-facing architecture discussions and technical workshops.
